items.title: 52157_Count Basie oral history interview
items.q: I met the Mayor and he gave me the key, was very nice man.

ctx.x: No, they had planned on a motor thing, but nothing come of that, and it was just as well because I think it was a little wet -- but then it turned out to be marvelous and that little thing -- they had a little afternoon program and I met the Mayor and he gave me the key, was very nice man. He's an awful groovy man, that Mayor. He's very fine young and nice.
